allowedCapabilities.description: Capabilities a grant made while the phase runs may carry, under governance.phaseCapabilities (issue #4); without it grants are per run.
allowedCapabilities.title: Allowedcapabilities

dependsOn.description: Earlier phases whose latest attempt must have passed before this phase starts, under governance.enforceWorkflow (the order of the nine phases stays fixed).
dependsOn.title: Dependson

exitGate.description: Name of the condition the phase must meet to pass: evaluated from the run's records under governance.enforceWorkflow (an unmet one leaves the attempt BLOCKED); recorded with each attempt (exitGate, exitGateMet) under governance.applyWorkflowSettings or governance.enforceWorkflow.
exitGate.title: Exitgate

maxAttempts.description: Failed attempts of the phase after which it is not started again, under governance.applyWorkflowSettings.
maxAttempts.title: Maxattempts

parallelizable.description: Under governance.enforceWorkflow, the phase's independent read-only work may run at once: the validators declared parallelSafe of VERIFICATION. Phases themselves and the sub-tasks of a decomposition run one at a time on the run's workspace.
parallelizable.title: Parallelizable

timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock budget of one attempt of the phase under governance.applyWorkflowSettings.
timeoutSeconds.title: Timeoutseconds

validators.description: Declarative: the validators come from the profiles and the project.
validators.title: Validators

invariants.description: Declarative: names of invariants the engine enforces in code.
invariants.title: Invariants
